name: Grouped Next Event Estimation
aliases: Weighted Reservoir Sampling for Next Event
definition: An optimization for next event estimation that reduces computational complexity by grouping kernels. It rewrites the single summation of light transport interactions into a double summation over groups and kernels within those groups, enabling importance sampling at the group level.
summary: Grouped Next Event Estimation reduces Monte Carlo complexity by clustering kernels into groups and hierarchically sampling to avoid full probability matrix construction.
